issue.title: Recover missing bob-cli prompt-archive object for kellys_mbp.8
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-196.6.2 note #1 while publishing the two pending bob-cli objects. On 2026-09-25 the current checkout command .venv/bin/sase agent prompts validate -p gh_bobs-org__bob-cli --json reports artifact-missing for prompts/202609/bbugyi200.kellys_mbp.8.md targeting files/objects/sha256/8a/8adbb12dd7ecc1b7382177f85ac437b79038a2a559e306144c49a8bf1445592e. The bob-cli agents sidecar is clean and tracks origin/main; commit 47ac0f47 published the two other hash-valid pending objects. The target object remains absent. Locate the exact digest-matching original bytes on Kelly or another authorized archive, publish them through the current sync path, and verify bob-cli prompt validation is error-free. Do not invent bytes or alter the archived prompt.

task_type_fields.impact: bob-cli prompt archive validation remains red despite publication of its two pending objects.
task_type_fields.repro: Run .venv/bin/sase agent prompts validate -p gh_bobs-org__bob-cli --json from current sase checkout; artifact-missing persists after sidecar commit 47ac0f47.
